answer: Proof-of-stake defends against Sybils by requiring AI agents to lock scarce tokens for identity validation. Each fake identity, even if costing a mere sparrow's worth individually, accumulates to a substantial economic barrier. An attacker's capital reaches its nadir swiftly when attempting to influence the network against the prevailing tide of honest participants, as they must acquire a significant portion of the total circulating supply to gain any meaningful adversarial power.
